captionSetupDescription: Create your family or class. You will be the first person with access.
captionPairDeviceDescription: An adult enters the code from the parents' area. After that, children can practise on this device.
captionNoProfiles: No children yet – please add them in the parents' area.
captionInvitationSignedInAs: You are signed in as {{name}}. Join the family with one click.
labelAdultEntry: I am a mum, dad or teacher
labelFamilyName: Name of the family or class
labelPrivacyAccept: I agree to the processing of my data as described in the privacy notice.
labelLoginToAccept: Sign in and accept the invitation
notificationNetworkError: No connection. Please try again in a moment.
notificationSessionExpired: You have been signed out. Please sign in again.
notificationInvalidInput: Something is wrong with the input. Please check it again.
notificationAccessDenied: You don't have permission to do that.
notificationUnexpectedError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
notificationLoginFailed: Email or password is incorrect. After too many attempts, signing in is blocked for a short time.
notificationNoMembership: You no longer belong to a family. Please ask an adult of the family to invite you again.
notificationEmailNotConfirmed: Please confirm your email address first. You will find the link in our email.
notificationResetLinkSent: If an account exists for this email, we have sent you a link to reset your password.
notificationPasswordChanged: Your password has been changed. You can sign in now.
notificationLinkExpired: This link is invalid or has expired.
notificationSetupAlreadyDone: Merkwerk has already been set up.
notificationAccountLocked: Too many attempts. The account is temporarily locked.
notificationPasswordTooShort: The password needs at least 10 characters.
notificationEmailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
notificationPrivacyRequired: Please agree to the privacy notice.
notificationPairingCodeInvalid: The code is invalid or has expired.
notificationTooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again later.
notificationDeviceNotPaired: This device is no longer paired. Please pair it again.
notificationInvitationAccountExists: There is already an account for this e-mail address. Please sign in to accept the invitation.
captionChildNameHint: First name or nickname only – no surnames.
captionConfirmDeleteChild: Really delete {{name}}? All tasks and progress will be lost.
captionConfirmRemoveMember: Remove {{name}} from the family? Their access to the family ends.
captionConfirmResetPassword: {{name}} gets a start password by e-mail (valid for 24 hours) and must then choose their own. All of {{name}}'s sessions end.
notificationChildLimitReached: A family can have at most 10 children.
notificationAlreadyMember: This person already belongs to the family.
notificationInvitationSent: The invitation to {{email}} has been sent.
notificationMemberRemoved: The person was removed from the family.
notificationStartPasswordSent: The start password has been sent by e-mail.
captionDevicesDescription: Tablets and phones your children practise on. There, children sign in just by tapping their picture.
captionPairingInstructions: Open Merkwerk on the tablet, tap “I want to practise” and enter the code – or scan the QR code with the tablet's camera. The code is valid for 10 minutes and works only once.
captionConfirmRevokeDevice: Unpair “{{name}}”? Practising on this device works again only after pairing it anew.
captionSubjectsDescription: Every subject has a color and an icon, so children recognise it even before they can read. Subjects apply to everyone on this Merkwerk instance.
captionNoGroups: No groups yet. Later, groups let you assign exercises to several children at once.
captionGroupEmpty: No children in this group yet
captionConfirmDeleteGroup: The group "{{name}}" will be deleted. The children stay.
captionGroupNoChildren: Add children first – then you can choose them here.
notificationGroupLimitReached: A family can have at most 20 groups.
notificationGroupChildrenChanged: The children of the family have changed. Please close the dialog and try again.
captionExercisesDescription: Exercises with your own questions or with the arithmetic generator. Children can only get published exercises.
captionExerciseTitleHint: For example “Plus up to 20” or “Animals in English”.
captionContentSourceLocked: Delete all questions first to switch to the arithmetic generator.
captionNoQuestions: No questions yet. Add the first one below.
captionQuestionPromptHint: The task as the child reads it and hears it read aloud.
captionClozeHint: Put gaps in square brackets, several right answers with |, e.g. “The [dog|puppy] barks.”
captionMatchHint: Write the pairs that belong together in one row. Children see the right side shuffled.
captionNumberToleranceHint: Empty = exact. For example 0.1 allows a difference of 0.1.
captionTenTransitionHint: Applies to plus and minus, e.g. 8 + 5 or 13 − 5.
captionGeneratorPreviewHint: Every child gets new numbers in every round.
notificationExerciseTitleRequired: Please enter a title (at most 100 characters).
notificationPublishNeedsQuestions: Add at least one question before publishing.
notificationTooManyQuestions: An exercise can have at most 50 questions.
notificationQuestionInvalid: This question is not complete yet.
notificationQuestionPromptRequired: Please enter a task text (at most 500 characters).
notificationChoiceCorrectRequired: Mark at least one right answer.
notificationAcceptedAnswersRequired: At least one filled-in right answer is needed.
notificationAcceptedAnswersNotNumbers: With number input, all right answers must be numbers (e.g. 12 or 0.5).
notificationNumberToleranceInvalid: The allowed difference must be a number from 0.
notificationClozeGapsInvalid: The text needs 1 to 10 gaps in square brackets.
notificationClozeGapEmpty: Every gap needs a right answer.
notificationMatchPairsInvalid: 2 to 8 completely filled-in pairs are needed.
notificationFlashcardSidesRequired: Front and back must be filled in.
notificationNumberRangeInvalid: The number range must be between 5 and 1000.
notificationTaskCountInvalid: The number of tasks must be between 1 and 50.
notificationTenTransitionInvalid: Crossing a ten only works with plus or minus and from number range 20.
